text:
Rowan Blake: quick triage for Raven private/VPC onboarding: two blockers reported in CS-5209 — KMS access failing in their CI and audit log delivery to their SIEM (172.16.9.14). can we troubleshoot?

Chen Li: looked at the CI logs: `kms:GenerateDataKey AccessDenied`. ask them to paste `aws sts get-caller-identity --query Arn --output text` from the CI job.

Tara Mendes: they provided a principal in the key policy that includes the session suffix. common mistake — policy must reference the role ARN, not assumed-role session. sample suggestion i sent: "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::667788990011:role/raven-ci"}

Omar Haddad: also check for conditions like `kms:ViaService` or `StringEquals` on `aws:SourceAccount` that could block CI. asked Raven to paste the entire key policy.

Rowan Blake: Raven pasted policy fragment, it used `assumed-role/raven-ci/*` as principal. told them to replace with role ARN and they are applying now.

onboard-bot: Reminder: private onboarding checklist includes "KMS principal exact ARN" and "egress DNS/IP + SG rules" (runbook updated 2026-03-21).

Chen Li: next — audit logs: our outbound NAT shows RST to 172.16.9.14:443. if their endpoint resolves to private IP, confirm peering/transit and that their SIEM accepts connections from our egress IPs. asked Raven to ask SIEM team to check incoming TLS rejects.

Tara Mendes: suggested tests for Raven: 1) from their bastion `curl -v https://logs.raven-sec.internal:443/health` 2) from our NAT `curl -v https://logs.raven-sec.internal:443/health` and paste both outputs. also suggested `openssl s_client -connect 172.16.9.14:443 -servername logs.raven-sec.internal` to check cert/SNI.

Omar Haddad: noted renewal risk: onboarding is at day 9 (SLA 7). if we still have unresolved network/KMS issues in 48h, escalate to AM. I'll create a short risk note on CS-5209.

Rowan Blake: Raven returned `aws sts` output: `arn:aws:sts::667788990011:assumed-role/raven-ci/runner-3`. they patched the key policy to role ARN and retriggered the pipeline. KMS step passed on second attempt.

Chen Li: good. ask Raven to attach the SIEM TLS logs and curl output. if still failing we can do a brief pairing session and run `tcpdump` on NAT to see TLS alerts.

Tara Mendes: capture feedback item: onboarding docs confusing re: role vs assumed-role principal. i'll add an example pair to the runbook and a short blurb in the post-onboard survey for AM to collect.

onboard-bot: Action created: ONB-9911  Add role vs assumed-role examples to private onboarding docs (assigned Tara Mendes).

Rowan Blake: thanks team 44d will update CS-5209 after Raven shares SIEM logs. closing for now.
